_comment: Runtime knobs for fl-county-watch. Cadence is NOT read by the pipeline; the scheduler (GitHub Actions / cron) owns frequency. Flip election_window to true in the scheduler to raise cadence during the election window. `workers` applies to plain fetches only — headless renders are always serialized to protect determinism.

cadence.note: baseline = daily 08:00 UTC; election window = every 3 hours. Adjust freely.
